first_credible_root_cause: the candidate-audit runner required every request to have a deterministic material blueprint even though the product service had already executed and retained candidates for requests that correctly required later explicit scope
business_impact: DELL retrieval ran, but no immutable full projection was written, so the business-level candidate result could not be audited
disposition: allow explicit_scope_required only in candidate-provenance audit mode, keep the result visibly material-scope incomplete, and use a fresh R3 replay
